job.title: [Post] ... looking for an experienced SAP Commerce Cloud Technical Lead to drive ... CCV2 #Java #…

tailoring.headline: Senior SAP Commerce Cloud Developer | Java, Spring & OCC REST APIs
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with 5+ years delivering enterprise e-commerce platforms on SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2105/2211) for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Expert in Java, Spring, Spring Boot, OCC REST APIs, microservices, and CI/CD on CCv2. Proven record designing PIM/ERP/MDM integrations, API migrations, and supporting production in agile, techno-functional roles with international stakeholders.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: SAP Commerce Cloud Technical Lead
cover_en.hook: I am excited about the opportunity to drive SAP Commerce Cloud excellence at your company. With over five years of hands-on experience delivering large-scale e-commerce solutions for Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring deep expertise in Java, Spring and CCv2 deployments. My techno-functional background ensures I can bridge business goals with robust technical delivery.

bullets.label: Technical Expertise
bullets.text: Designed and implemented end-to-end SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2211) solutions, building OCC REST APIs and integrating PIM/ERP/MDM data pipelines to support global storefronts.

bullets.label: Integration Leadership
bullets.text: Led API migration projects and resolved complex integration bottlenecks between SAP ERP, MDM and Profisee, improving system stability and data consistency.

bullets.label: Agile Delivery
bullets.text: Delivered CI/CD cycles on CCv2, performed production support, and mentored junior developers within Scrum teams, ensuring high-quality releases.

bullets.label: Business Collaboration
bullets.text: Worked directly with international business stakeholders to analyse requirements, author user stories and functional specs, translating them into scalable commerce features.

cover_en.logistics: Based in Karlsruhe, Germany with a valid work permit. Serving notice until 15 December 2026, earliest start 16 December 2026. Open to remote, hybrid or on-site arrangements.

tailoring.why_company: Your focus on innovative, cloud-native e-commerce experiences aligns perfectly with my passion for building scalable SAP Commerce Cloud solutions. I admire your commitment to leveraging AI-assisted development and continuous delivery, areas where I have delivered measurable impact at Rockwell Automation and Shell. Joining your team would allow me to contribute my deep technical expertise while growing within a forward-thinking organization.
tailoring.motivation_short: I want to apply my SAP Commerce Cloud expertise to help your company deliver cutting-edge e-commerce experiences and drive digital transformation.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hi, I’m a senior SAP Commerce Cloud developer with 5+ years of experience at Rockwell Automation and Shell. I’m interested in the Technical Lead role and would love to discuss how I can add value to your team.
tailoring.email_subject: Application for SAP Commerce Cloud Technical Lead
tailoring.email_body: Please find attached my CV and cover letter for the SAP Commerce Cloud Technical Lead position. I bring over five years of senior-level experience delivering SAP Commerce Cloud solutions for global enterprises, strong Java/Spring expertise, and a proven record in integration and production support. I look forward to the opportunity to discuss how I can contribute to your team.
